column1: # CI support matrix. One row per series and target. Tab separated.
# series    PHP series, matching the backports/php-<series> branch
# target    linux, linux-arm64, windows-x64, or windows-x86
# runner    JSON array of GitHub runner labels
# platform  docker --platform for the container path, or - for Windows
# crt       Visual C++ generation for the Windows path: vs16, vc15, or vc14
# arch      Windows target architecture: x64 or x86
# toolset   MSVC toolset passed to the SDK runner with -s, or -
# suites    test paths handed to run-tests.php, space separated
# marker    runner marker required to include this row, or -
# configure configure flags for the container build, or - for the default
# A row whose marker is not enabled stays out of the matrix. That keeps a
# self-hosted job from queueing for hours when its machine is off. Enable a
# marker with the workflow_dispatch input, or with a pull request label named
# ci:<marker>, for example ci:win-legacy.
# PHP 5.6 has no Windows row on purpose. phpsdk_setshell.bat refuses any CRT
# below vc14, and the vc11 dependency set survives only under
# downloads.php.net/~windows/php-sdk/deps/archives/vc11. Windows 5.6 needs a
# driver built on the pre-2.0 SDK, which is a research task rather than a row.
series
